snippet.title: Stay Still - Official Console Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the console launch trailer for Stay Still, a first-person psychological horror game inspired by Vietnamese culture and urban legends. Play as Nam and explore a home filled with oppressive rooms while solving puzzles and avoiding the spirits that stalk you. Stay Still is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S.
